title: FDN mirrors · XMage
summary: Sixteen Foundations draft decks from 17lands' public Premier Draft data (CC BY 4.0), as sampled by DraftZero, on the XMage engine; both seats play the same list, and every matchup plays each deck in both seats. Fairness: validator only (P's live validator checks every decision; no probe). Halted and truncated games are unrated and shown with their rates.
